title: Trump-Backed Rep. Andy Ogles Loses Tennessee GOP Primary
detail: Tennessee Rep. Andy Ogles, a House Freedom Caucus member under federal campaign-finance investigation, lost his 5th District Republican primary to former state Agriculture Commissioner Charlie Hatcher on August 6, 2026. The Associated Press called the race for Hatcher at 10:10 p.m. with a final margin of 53%-47%, despite Trump's endorsement of Ogles. Hatcher was backed by establishment Republicans. Ogles becomes the third sitting House Republican to lose a renomination bid in the 2026 cycle, underscoring intra-party volatility heading into the midterms even where Trump's endorsement was on the line.

media.caption: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary to Charlie Hatcher in Tennessee's 5th District

title: Trump Signs New Executive Orders Narrowing Birthright Citizenship, Targeting 'Birth Tourism'
detail: President Trump signed two new executive orders on August 6, 2026, weeks after the Supreme Court upheld birthright citizenship as constitutionally protected and struck down his original January 2025 order. The first order expands a narrow exception to birthright citizenship to exclude children of people deemed to be attempting to 'purchase' citizenship, alleged terrorists, and certain people born in US territories. The second delegates authority to the Secretaries of State and Homeland Security to halt 'birth tourism' — foreign nationals traveling to the US specifically to give birth. Trump called the narrower orders 'adjustments' in response to the Court's ruling; both are expected to face immediate legal challenges.

media.caption: Trump signs new executive orders narrowing birthright citizenship and targeting birth tourism
